text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear pro position in opening and closing","quality":"stance clarity","description":"It states a definite position and returns to it at the end, so the reader always knows where the writer stands."},{"evidence":"mentions accidents, sensors, and driver alerts from the article","quality":"use of evidence","description":"It brings in relevant details from the source to support its argument instead of relying mostly on unsupported claims."},{"evidence":"“However... negative things... what if a car fails...”","quality":"balanced reasoning","description":"It acknowledges counterarguments and limitations before restating its own view, which makes the argument feel more considered."},{"evidence":"“there's alot of positive outcomes...”, “I think this idea... should be considered”","quality":"organization","description":"It has a basic argumentative structure with introduction, body, and conclusion that helps the essay progress logically."},{"evidence":"“wouldnt a driver just get bored” and “you could just relax and be on your phone”","quality":"explanatory development","description":"It expands on ideas with brief reasons and examples rather than leaving each point as a single sentence claim."}]}
